decision: hold pending original absolute-scale conversion review
reason: HOLD: author follow-up (Tennett et al. 2018, DOI 10.1242/jeb.180117) reports that wild harbor/gray seal kinematics in Garrett and Fish lacked an absolute scale and used relative measures. The compilation conversion to absolute km/h must be independently established before admission. https://journals.biologists.com/jeb/article/221/18/jeb180117/19448/Terrestrial-locomotion-of-the-northern-elephant
scope: Land-travel entries only; swimming entries and other taxa are not withdrawn by this review.
